questions.text: Which branch holds the most account balance?

gt_sql.sqlite: SELECT br.branch_name, ROUND(SUM(a.balance),2) s FROM accounts a JOIN branches br ON a.branch_id=br.branch_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 1
